hero.headline: TOTAL STATION DTM 152M
hero.title: DTM 152M – Precision Total Station for Demanding Surveys
hero.description: SmartGrid Surveying offers the DTM 152M total station, designed for reliable angle and distance measurements in construction, cadastral, and engineering projects.

productOverview.headline: DTM 152M Total Station
productOverview.description: The DTM 152M is a robust total station combining precision optics with advanced electronic distance measurement (EDM) technology. Built for durability in the field, it delivers accurate data for a wide range of surveying applications, from topographic mapping to construction layout.

items.title: DTM 152M
items.description: A robust total station designed for precision tasks such as topographic mapping, setting out, and deformation monitoring.

items.title: E SURVEY E3L
items.description: A versatile total station offering high-accuracy angle measurement and long-range EDM capability for general surveying and construction layout.

otherProducts.headline: OTHER RELATED PRODUCTS
